annotations.title: Query Policy, Zoning and Community Pushback

description: Checks a county, city, state, or project location for data center moratoria, zoning ordinances, regulatory review thresholds, and community opposition activity.

county.description: County or parish name (e.g. 'Loudoun County', 'Warren County').

latitude.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. 39.4476).

load_mw.description: Proposed load in megawatts to check statutory large-load review thresholds (e.g. 100).

location.description: City, county, or metro area (e.g. 'Warren County, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

longitude.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees WGS84 (e.g. -84.1746).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Optional project ID to screen local moratoria and community pushback (e.g. 'P017').

project_name.description: Optional project name to screen (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene').

query.description: Location, county, or project query for policy and pushback screening (e.g. 'Prince William County, VA').

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers around the location (default: 50).

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.
